name: table
title: Table
description: Composable data-table primitives — Table, TableRoot, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, plus higher-level pieces (TableToolbar with selection slots, TablePagination with rows-per-page picker, TableStatus pill, TableLink, and TableExpandToggle). Supports sortable headers, selected rows with brand rail, expandable rows, sub-rows, and numeric columns. Pixel-perfect port of Figma node 2436:798 (Pantheon › Data Table).
